manual_impact_questions: Which user-visible outcome and protected behavior can change?
Which callers, ViewModels, Room tables/queries, error paths, migrations, and relaunch outcomes are affected?
Which notification, Service, Worker, Receiver, update, media, or OS consumers share this contract?
Does an existing Oracle fail on a credible wrong value/state, or must the change add or strengthen one?

minimum_evidence: quality selector unit/negative controls
Android JVM suite and androidTest compilation
escalation_reasons: Test infrastructure changes require representative product evidence; syntax alone is insufficient.

minimum_evidence: androidTest compilation

exact changed @Test method when diff attribution is reliable, otherwise every runnable method in the changed instrumented class; required execution profiles and exact fresh XML selector identities must match before evidence is accepted
known_evidence_gaps: Dynamic diff attribution narrows Kotlin @Test changes; helper and fixture changes expand to every runnable method, and shared support changes expand to every statically referenced runnable consumer. Deleted, renamed, unknown, or unresolved sources block before execution. Specialized permission, system, accessibility, and App-owned profiles remain distinct.
escalation_reasons: Instrumented-test changes require device execution; compilation alone cannot validate the Oracle.

minimum_evidence: host-driven denied permission to App explanation to real Android Settings enable and return-refresh journey
semantic enabled-state verifier
focused durable critical inbound to system notification/USAGE_ALARM playback/PendingIntent/stop journey
focused Settings to Private foreground Service/system notification/persistence/stop journey
permission-precondition attribution negative controls
known_evidence_gaps: Controlled emulator proves the actual Android permission decision and Settings surfaces, but does not prove real external FCM/private delivery, physical audible output, Doze, reboot/package replacement, OEM behavior, or process-death cold start.
escalation_reasons: A changed system-route test must execute its own system surface; the routine PR UI subset cannot validate it.

minimum_evidence: host-driven canonical unread message to exact detail/read mutation to verified no-PID to new-PID restart to exact persisted detail/read state
production Open URL action to unique HTTPS handler, exact user-visible canonical browser URL, and return to the same accurate detail
App-owned session preparation and teardown completion
one-time wrong-body and wrong-url sensitivity controls
known_evidence_gaps: Controlled-emulator force-stop proves a real Linux process boundary and durable App-owned Room/UI state, but does not prove low-memory OS eviction, reboot, OEM task policy, physical-device startup timing, or production-data migration.
escalation_reasons: Process lifecycle tests must prove both process identity change and a durable user outcome; Activity recreation or a PID check alone is insufficient.

minimum_evidence: stable preparation phase and cleanup on failure
invalid App-owned session stops within 10 seconds without business UI or retry
normal empty.clean reaches readiness and the accurate functional empty state
known_evidence_gaps: Controlled-emulator timing does not prove physical-device startup performance.
escalation_reasons: The external App-owned control owns real process preparation and must never leave a partial Session or report a Binder shell return code as business readiness.

minimum_evidence: focused settings transaction/error/recovery/decryption device journeys with final UI and durable state
gateway post-commit sync failure keeps the new gateway active, reports pending recovery, and preserves it after relaunch
known_evidence_gaps: Device journeys use controlled transport and ingress boundaries; real external FCM/private delivery and physical KeyStore implementations remain NOT RUN.
escalation_reasons: A changed settings journey must execute itself and retain exact failure, no-commit, recovery, message, and ACK outcomes.

minimum_evidence: exact 1k-store startup/detail product Oracle on controlled emulator
Macrobenchmark JSON contract and negative controls
filtered Baseline/Startup Profile and Release APK isolation
explicit physical-device budgets or truthful NOT RUN
known_evidence_gaps: Emulator timing never proves a user-device budget; physical startup/detail/frame evidence requires an explicitly selected non-personal device and owner-approved budgets.
escalation_reasons: Performance tests cross app-owned storage, packaged Release-like code, device compatibility, profiler output, and user-visible correctness.

minimum_evidence: QualityRuntime JVM tests
invalid App-owned session stops in its exact preparation phase within 10 seconds
normal empty.clean preparation reaches readiness and the accurate functional empty state
Release build/runtime isolation
escalation_reasons: Composition-root or Runtime changes cross Room lifecycle and Release boundaries.

minimum_evidence: DAO/query correctness
old-version migration and reopen device tests
representative UI content/relaunch journeys
known_evidence_gaps: Controlled-emulator App-owned startup reliability is proven 50/50; one v21-to-current migration representative now reaches accurate real list/detail UI after Container reopen, while other source versions and physical-device startup remain NOT RUN.
escalation_reasons: Room schema/query changes affect all canonical and derived consumers.

minimum_evidence: JVM/Room message/search/deletion tests
Android accurate content/search/delete/relaunch UI journeys
Android provider refresh new-result/failure-recovery UI journeys
known_evidence_gaps: media performance remains incomplete; representative Android pagination/read, page-owned failure/retry, and new-result/failure-recovery refresh workflows are protected.

minimum_evidence: Android failed search must not masquerade as empty or stale results; Retry reaches one exact canonical result and matching detail
known_evidence_gaps: This focused recovery path does not claim index-rebuild integrity, 10k/100k search latency, physical-device behavior, or every query-normalization permutation.
escalation_reasons: Search presentation and query-owner changes can otherwise ship a plausible empty or stale list while the user cannot recover to the requested canonical message.

minimum_evidence: entity projection/repository tests
Android Event close/filter/relaunch and Thing accurate list/detail/relation/relaunch journeys
known_evidence_gaps: Event close slow/error/duplicate-submit recovery is protected at both entry points. Precise single-Thing delete/control-object/relaunch is protected; deep links, bulk/channel deletion, and tombstones remain incomplete.
escalation_reasons: Entity data/projection owners feed lists, details, relations, ingress, and notifications.

minimum_evidence: Android broad positive UI representative set including Event close/filter/relaunch and Thing accurate search/single-delete/control-object/three-relation/relaunch
known_evidence_gaps: Pure screen composition changes do not automatically run failure injection, deep-link, bulk-delete, or tombstone matrices; run the owning focused risk path when the diff changes one of those contracts.
escalation_reasons: Pure presentation and stable action-entry changes need real positive UI outcomes without automatically consuming all Entity failure-recovery and data-boundary scenarios.

minimum_evidence: TransportSwitchCoordinator prepare/commit/query/recovery JVM transaction contract
real Settings FCM/private selector rejection-preserves-active-route/retry/commit/relaunch journey
real Settings local-finalize-failure/relaunch/retry journey
known_evidence_gaps: Stateful controlled Gateway evidence does not prove a real Gateway, real FCM/private delivery, process-death recovery, system Service/notification behavior, or physical-device behavior.
escalation_reasons: The coordinator owns durable remote/local transport cutover ordering, unknown-result reconciliation, CAS supersession, and restart recovery.

minimum_evidence: validation/service/transport integration tests
real Channel local-validation/remote-rejection/sheet-error ownership/create-compensation/reload/retry/rename/keep-history/delete-history/relaunch journey
real Settings page-visibility action/destination and relaunch journey
real server invalid/candidate-registration-failure/no-commit/retry/normalize/data-scope/relaunch journey
real server post-commit sync failure/pending-recovery/relaunch journey
real decryption invalid/status/no-echo/clear/relaunch journey
real FCM/private selector rejection-preserves-active-route/local-commit-rollback/retry/commit/relaunch journey
known_evidence_gaps: Channel local validation, accepted creation and existing-channel subscription (created=false), remote password rejection, and remote compensation for an explicit created=true result after local persistence failure have real-control journeys, as do page visibility, gateway validation rejection, local commit failure with successful rollback/restart/retry, server scoping, decryption lifecycle, protected-write compensation, wrong-key correction, valid recovery, corrupt-ciphertext safe failure, and the FCM/private selector's prepare-before-commit plus local-commit rollback behavior through typed transport boundaries. Safe remote ownership/idempotency compensation after a created=false subscription's local commit fails, rollback itself failing after transport selection, real external FCM/private delivery, and physical system behavior remain missing. Cross-store gateway recovery, atomic cleanup-state transitions, and route-error classification have host contracts only; actual process-death recovery, remote old-route cleanup, provider behavior, and emulator evidence remain NOT RUN. The three Gateway Compose journeys are NOT RUN/BLOCKED without an authorized device.
escalation_reasons: Credentials and remote/local reconciliation require failure and recovery evidence.

minimum_evidence: idempotency/ACK/retry/service policy JVM tests
device process/lifecycle boundaries
durable direct ingress to real system notification/PendingIntent and exact detail/read/dedupe/relaunch journey
real Settings selection to Private foreground Service/system notification/persistence/stop journey
final Room and UI state
known_evidence_gaps: real FCM/private transport, user permission denial/upgrade decisions, Doze, reboot, OEM behavior, process-death cold start, and physical audio remain NOT RUN.
escalation_reasons: Ingress and services cross process, durable work, notification, and UI consumers.

preview/share consumer UI
resource cleanup device evidence

escalation_reasons: Machine-consumed update metadata can prevent or misdirect user updates without changing App source.

controlled PackageInstaller version advance and exact post-upgrade data
Release contract
production signing and physical/OEM install explicitly NOT RUN unless supplied

minimum_evidence: App state/navigation JVM tests
real control navigation UI journey including one applicable high-risk badge/loading/error/disabled state
escalation_reasons: App composition/navigation affects reachability of every downstream capability.

minimum_evidence: a deleted message opened from a stale App notification returns to the usable Messages list with a clear unavailable-item explanation
the deleted message must not revive or produce an empty detail, while a surviving message remains openable with its exact content
known_evidence_gaps: This controlled App-owned Intent journey proves stale-target handling after local deletion. Delivery, system notification posting, physical-device notification permissions, and OEM process behavior remain separate evidence boundaries.
escalation_reasons: A notification that outlives local deletion can otherwise lead the user to a blank or misleading detail; the fallback must be verified from the actual notification-routing entry point.

minimum_evidence: accessibility semantics/contrast tests
representative core UI task
nightly locale/font review
known_evidence_gaps: API 37 zh-CN fontScale 1.5 message-detail/channel-create task and production localization completeness are covered. Physical TalkBack and risk-representative additional device/locale tasks remain NOT RUN.

minimum_evidence: product reachability review before any UI claim
known_evidence_gaps: No confirmed user entry exists; do not add UI tests that invoke helpers directly.
escalation_reasons: Unreachable helpers must be connected or removed, never counted as a user capability.

Release APK build
